text:
Alex W: Heads up: PR #2345 preview failed - linkcheck + vale complaining about passive voice in migration guide. Only one failing anchor and a wording line. Can someone pick up a quick patch? Need merge before rc-1 freeze. @Maria P?
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #2345: linkcheck error: broken anchor '#old-config' in /docs/migrate.md:45; vale: 'PassiveVoice' at migrate.md:120. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
Maria P: On it. I can swap the wording and update the anchor. Quick q — should we keep a redirect anchor for backward compat so old links don't 404?
Alex W: Prefer keeping a redirect if it's trivial. If not, update cross-links across repo. If you update the anchor, run linkcheck locally first to avoid another CI round:
```bash
# build preview locally and run link check
yarn && yarn docs:build && python -m pip install linkchecker && linkchecker file://$PWD/_build/html/index.html
# or re-run GH action if you prefer:
gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=2345
```
Maria P: I'll push a tiny commit that preserves the old anchor and adds the new one where it matters. Ping when CI green. ETA ~15m.
ci-bot: Re-run requested: workflow docs-preview.yml queued for PR #2345 by Maria P (user/maria).
Samir: I can review after CI passes. I'm oncall but can squeeze this in. If it's just anchor + one-line reword, quick approval.
Kev: :thumbsup: If merge timing matters, set merge window to 'patch' and tag me for final look.
Maria P: Pushed fix in commit a1b2c3d (branch: docs/fix/migrate-anchor).
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded for PR #2345 — all checks green (linkcheck, spellcheck, vale). Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-2345
Alex W: Samir, Kev — can one of you approve? I'll merge after approval and run final docs-deploy.
Samir: Approving now. :white_check_mark:
Kev: Approved. Merge when ready, Alex.
Alex W: Merged and cherry-picked to release/rc-1. Running docs deploy now. Thanks all :tada:
